title: Reply to Any Email in 10 Seconds
style: Read this like a funny, energetic friend in a quick social video. Playful on the joke, then clear and upbeat.

segments.title: 47 unread emails. Zero energy.
segments.say: Forty-seven unread emails and zero energy to answer them? Let AI write the first draft.

segments.title: The reply-for-me prompt
bullets: Say what you want to happen
segments.say: Paste the email you got. Then say: write a reply that, and what you want to happen. Add the tone and the length. You just edit and hit send.

chat.user: Here's an email: [paste]. Write a reply that says no refund after 30 days, but offers store credit. Kind, under 80 words.
chat.ai: Hi Maria, I'm sorry the table isn't working out. Our refund window is 30 days, but we'd be happy to give you full store credit. Stop by any time!

segments.title: Follow for more AI tricks
bullets: Copy the prompt from the description
segments.say: Which email do you hate answering the most? Tell me below. Follow Run It With AI for a new trick every week.
